metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.displayName: MITRE T1055.011: Extra Window Memory Injection
properties.description: Detects ATT&CK technique T1055.011 (Extra Window Memory Injection). Adversaries may inject malicious code into process via Extra Window Memory (EWM) in order to evade process-based defenses as well as possibly elevate privileges. EWM injection is a method of executing
properties.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4688 | where NewProcessName contains "mitre" or CommandLine contains "t1055" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, Account, NewProcessName | where count_ > 5 // AZ-MITRE-ATTACK-021
